item.title: 13 reacciones | #Eleição2026 - Os presidentes do Senado Federal, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), e da Câmara dos Deputados, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), discursaram após a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Motta afirmou que a eleição de Lula traz a certeza que o Brasil tem um "bom sistema" eleitoral, inclusive pela rapidez na apuração. O presidente da Câmara afirmou ainda que espera que Lula faça uma avaliação dos seus acertos e erros no terceiro mandato e que todos têm pontos a melhorar. Davi Alcolumbre disse que o parlamento tem "papel fundamental na busca de soluções para a população" e que Câmara e Senado ecoam as "demandas, sonhos e angústias" do país. Alcolumbre afirmou que "não há o que se contestar" e que "a vitória, em primeiro plano, foi da democracia". Líderes do Judiciário também se manifestaram. Veja mais em #g1. #eleição #política #g1política | g1 - O Portal de Notícias da globo

item.title: Israel braces for national elections seen as a referendum on Netanyahu
item.description: Israelis are preparing to head to the polls on Tuesday (October 27) in the first elections since the October 7th attacks in 2023. Unable to vote abroad, expatriate citizens have been flying in from around the world to participate in a vote widely seen as being a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: La idea in extremis del Gobierno para los alquileres: que los caseros avisen del fin de los contratos con seis meses de antelación
item.description: Ni la corrupción. Ni el paro. Ni la sanidad. Para sorpresa de nadie (al menos si tenemos en cuenta el CIS), lo que ha puesto patas arriba el calendario político español es la crisis residencial . El desahucio de Maricarmen y la presión de los acampados en Madrid obligaron al Gobierno a presentar a comienzos de octubre dos decretos exprés sobre vivienda que, al no recibir el respaldo del Congreso, llevaron a Pedro Sánchez a adelantar las elecciones al 29-N. No fue el único movimiento del Ejecutivo. Hace unas semanas aprobó dos nuevos decretos similares (ambos ya publicados en el BOE) que… Fuente: Xataka.

item.description: Hopes raised for a reset in relations with EU and other partners following the defeat of authoritarian president Serbian leader ousted by student movement in seismic election Back to Serbia, we are expecting to hear from two groups of election monitors in the coming hours: first, very shortly, from Serbia’s Center for Research, Transparency and Accountability (CRTA), and then a bit later from a group of international observers, including from the OSCE, the ODIHR, and the European parliament. I will keep an eye on their findings and bring you the key lines. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Macron vows ‘concrete’ measures to address student demands after unrest
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron on Monday said the government will announce "concrete and strong" measures to address the demands by high school students after their protests demanding better education conditions triggered weeks of nationwide unrest. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is set to hold a news conference after meeting with high school student unions. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Death of former PM Yasuo Fukuda leaves void in fraught China-Japan relations
item.description: Former Japanese prime minister Yasuo Fukuda, who championed closer ties with China during his brief tenure and later served as a crucial diplomatic intermediary during bilateral crises, has died at the age of 90. Fukuda died of heart failure on Thursday at a Tokyo hospital, Japanese media reported on Monday. His passing came as the relationship he spent decades nurturing faces its gravest test since diplomatic normalisation in 1972. Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun offered... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Alyssa Chen

item.title: French PM meets student representatives after weeks of protests
item.description: French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu is set to meet with high school students on Monday afternoon (October 26) to ease tensions in the country after nearly a month of protests. This follows another meeting in which French president Emmanuel Macron promised a concrete response to demands for better education standards and funding. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Israel: Arab Israeli voters could prove decisive in the upcoming elections
item.description: In Israel’s election the vote of Arab Israeli citizens could be crucial for the outcome and fate of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu who is standing for re-election. Traditionally voting turnout is lower among Arab Israelis than among the rest of the population. But this time some feel it’s their duty more than ever to cast their ballot given the policies and wars undertaken by Netanyahu. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: A look at the main issues in Israeli elections seen as a referendum on Netanyahu
item.description: Israelis will vote Tuesday (October 27) in the first national elections since Hamas' Oct. 7, 2023, attack in what is widely seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership. He rejected ICC war crimes claims and denied corruption as national elections approach. Details by FRANCE 24's correspondent in Jerusalem, Noga Tarnopolsky. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Lula beats Bolsonaro in Brazil runoff: What does it mean for Donald Trump?
item.description: Lula defeated on Sunday (October 25) Flavio Bolsonaro in Brazil’s presidential election. But rather than conceding, Bolsonaro called for the result to be annulled. As the US midterms approach, the result raises questions about Trump’s influence and how his political allies respond when voters reject them. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor, Douglas Herbert, gives us his analysis. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: US midterms: Trump's gains among Latino voters in Texas at risk
item.description: Latino voters shifted toward Trump two years ago, helping him return to the White House with a Republican-controlled Congress. Now, many are souring on the US president and his party. FRANCE 24's team reports from the Rio Grande Valley. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Israeli election seen as a referendum: For or against Netanyahu?
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has led his country almost continuously for nearly 17 years. But will he manage to retain power following Tuesday's election? Netanyahu's latest term has divided Israeli society more than ever and will be marked by the October 7 attacks, his handling of the conflicts in Gaza, Iran and Lebanon, as well as his controversial judicial reform. FRANCE 24's David Gilberg reports, with Lauren Bain. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: David GILBERG

item.title: Netanyahu faces voters in Israel's first election since 7 October
item.description: Israelis will vote Tuesday in the country’s first national election since Hamas’ October 7, 2023, attack, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s leadership, national security and the country’s future at the center of a deeply divisive campaign. Fuente: Africanews.

item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva agradeció a los jóvenes y a los adultos mayores por el respaldo que le permitió obtener una inédita victoria electoral y asegurar un cuarto mandato como presidente de Brasil. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.title: 25 Arizona voters wrongly flagged by Trump administration regain voting rights days before midterms
item.description: Twenty-five US citizens in Arizona have regained their voting access after being wrongly flagged as possible noncitizens. Their registrations were restored following court-ordered mediation between Maricopa County Recorder Justin Heap and Attorney General Kris Mayes on October 23. The agreement ended a lawsuit over the restrictions, allowing the affected citizens to vote in the November 3 midterm elections. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Nicki Minaj joined Donald Trump at a Republican rally in Michigan, declaring her support for the president. The event also saw Trump renew his attacks on Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed. Publicado también por: Euronews, BBC News - World. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Brazil: Thousands flood streets to celebrate Lula's election victory
item.description: Tears, hugs and dancing filled the streets of Brazil after Lula narrowly defeated Flávio Bolsonaro. Thousands celebrated in Rio and São Paulo as the president secured another four years in office. Publicado también por: Euronews. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Q&A: When it comes to democratic backsliding, our federalist system is a two-way street
item.description: As the 2026 midterm elections approach, the signs of democratic backsliding are everywhere across the U.S. political landscape. Troubling signs include the Trump administration's demand for state voter roll data and interference with mail-in voting, the pressure it applied to Georgia election officials to reverse Joe Biden's victory in that state in the 2020 election and, of course, extreme partisan gerrymandering of congressional districts. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: María Corina Machado recorrerá toda Venezuela para exigir elecciones
item.description: Nadie en Venezuela ha tenido un recibimiento con tanto júbilo, furor y entusiasmo como lo tuvo María Corina Machado este domingo, lo que ha consolidado su liderazgo como fenómeno político. Bastó que la líder anunciara en su cuenta de X a las 11:30 (16:30, hora peninsular española) que «Estoy aquí. Con ustedes» y, una hora más tarde, apareciera con su camiseta blanca y pantalones vaqueros en el santuario de la Divina Pastora en Santa Rosa de Barquisimeto, capital de Lara, para movilizar a millones de venezolanos que querían ver con sus propios ojos y tocar con sus manos a la mujer que desafió… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.description: The WSJ reports that Trump administration officials are floating former Hungarian prime minister Viktor Orbán for UN secretary-general, potentially backed by the US, Russia and China, though nothing is confirmed and his selection remains uncertain. Fuente: Euronews.

item.description: A poco más de una semana de las elecciones legislativas en EE.UU., el regreso de María Corina Machado a Venezuela puede ser un balón de oxígeno para algunos candidatos republicanos al Congreso en peligro. Y, por extensión, a Donald Trump: los dos años que le quedan de presidencia quedarán determinados por el poder que pueden alcanzar los demócratas en el Congreso.En un momento de gran impopularidad del multimillonario neoyorquino entre el electorado hispano, el retorno de Machado puede ser bien recibido por votantes clave en batallas como las de Florida o Texas . Y cualquier empujón puede ser… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Trump llama a Noruega “país de mierda” por no concederle el Nobel de la Paz
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha cargado duramente contra Noruega, país que acoge la entrega del Premio Nobel de la Paz, calificándolo de «país de mierda» tras mostrar su profundo enfado por no haber sido galardonado con este reconocimiento. En su lugar, el comité noruego premió a la jurista sudafricana Navanethem Pillay .Durante un mitin previo a las elecciones de medio mandato --que se celebrarán el próximo 3 de noviembre-- en Port Huron, en Míchigan, Trump ha justificado su rechazo a recibir inmigrantes noruegos (frente a su preferencia por ciudadanos de Dinamarca)… Publicado también por: ABC España - Internacional. Fuente: El País - Internacional.

item.title: ‘Baseless and false’: Israel def min rejects Netanyahu-army chief rift reports
item.description: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz has denied reports of military tensions concerning potential actions against Iran. Katz stated there are no plans for an attack before the upcoming elections. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu also rejected claims of disagreement with military chief Lieutenant General Eyal Zamir. In an interview, Netanyahu suggested that he had given instructions regarding the Iranian regime recently. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Brazil: What challenges await Lula in his fourth term as president?
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, nearly 81 years old, clinched a fourth term in a tight runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro on Sunday (October 25). He will have to wrestle with a divided Brazil, an unfriendly Congress, feeble public finances and a Donald Trump-shaped menace during his unprecedented fourth term. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Serbia's student movement ousts longtime leader Vucic in parliament poll
item.description: Serbia's Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat in an historic election on Sunday (October 25) following a near to 70% turnout at polling stations. The snap election followed nearly two years of student-led demonstrations against perceived corruption and authoritarianism triggered by the deaths of 16 people when a train station canopy collapsed in the ‌city of Novi Sad in 2024. FRANCE 24's Laurent Rouy tells us more. Publicado también por: The Hindu - International. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Why Poland wants a stronger relationship with India | The Hindu Editorial
item.description: Why is Poland seeking a closer partnership with India? Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk’s visit to India highlighted growing cooperation in trade, technology, defence, critical minerals, renewable energy and geopolitical coordination. With India and the European Union preparing to finalise a landmark Free Trade Agreement, Poland is positioning itself as a key European partner for New Delhi. This editorial explores what both countries stand to gain, the challenges that remain, and why the India-Poland relationship could become increasingly important in Europe’s engagement with India. Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Brazil's Lula seals re-election in surprise win
item.description: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won an unprecedented fourth term in a tight runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro on Sunday (October 25). The far-right candidate and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro has refused to accept the results and said he would seek to annul the vote. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: ‘Congratulations!’: World leaders hail Lula’s election victory in Brazil
item.description: The international community on Monday congratulated Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva after his stunning re-election in a runoff with right-wing candidate Flavio Bolsonaro. The region's left-leaning leaders were quick to react as Brazil staved off a conservative wave in many countries while Europeans, such as Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, celebrated a "progressive comeback". Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Leela JACINTO

item.title: Brexit deal is not good enough for British public, says Andy Burnham
item.description: EU exit has damaged economy and failed to bring promised benefits, says PM, but he rules out big pre-election changes UK politics live – latest updates Europe live – latest updates Brexit has not “played out” like it was promised to the public, has weakened the economy and the current deal is not good enough, Andy Burnham has said, while ruling out any major changes in the current parliament. The prime minister said Britain had ended up with a “harder Brexit than was proposed in the referendum campaign” and it had not helped to control the small boats crisis. Backing the home secretary’s… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Lula, en su discurso tras ganar las elecciones: «Mi victoria es una derrota de la mentira y del negacionismo»
item.description: El presidente reelecto de Brasil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, afirmó en la noche de este domingo que su victoria es una «derrota de la mentira y del negacionismo», después de imponerse por el 52 % de los votos frente al 48 % de su rival Flávio Bolsonaro en la segunda vuelta de las elecciones.Lula celebró la remontada inédita durante una comparecencia en un hotel de la ciudad de São Paulo, acompañado por su esposa Janja da Silva, el vicepresidente reelecto Geraldo Alckmin y otros aliados.«Voy a hacer el mejor mandato que un presidente hizo jamás en este país» , declaró, entre aplausos y vítores… Publicado también por: El País - Internacional. Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.description: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva pulled off a dramatic comeback on Sunday to clinch re-election to a fourth non-consecutive term. item.title: Trump asegura que «pronto» habrá acuerdo comercial con Canadá
item.description: Estados Unidos y Canadá alcanzarán «muy pronto» un acuerdo comercial, declaró el presidente Donald Trump el domingo en un mitin, poco más de una semana antes de las elecciones de medio mandato.Las tensiones entre los dos vecinos norteamericanos han estado tensas desde el colapso de las negociaciones comerciales en agosto, cuando Trump impuso nuevos aranceles.«Eso lo tendremos resuelto bastante pronto. En este momento están dispuestos a darnos cualquier cosa», declaró Trump sobre un posible acuerdo durante un mitin en Port Huron, una localidad del estado de Michigan en la frontera con Canadá… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Brazil keeps left: what Lula’s victory means for his country and beyond
item.description: In today’s newsletter: As Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva secured victory in the presidential race, we look the implications for democracy, the environment and international relations Good morning. Chances are you woke this morning to news of two momentous election results. In Serbia, a student-led movement has ousted the country’s long-serving leader, Aleksandar Vučić (which you can read more about here ). And just hours ago, Brazil’s president staged a sensational turnaround against his far-right opponent after a nail-biting vote. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, known as Lula, won a forth… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
